characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: Amy wears a sturdy, dark‑brown woolen tunic that reaches her knees, its coarse texture softened by years of use. Over the tunic she dons a worn leather apron tied at the waist, patched in several places where it has caught on mugs and barrels; the apron is deep brown with faded silver stitching. Her feet are covered by heavy, dark‑brown leather boots laced up to mid‑calf, scuffed from standing behind the bar all day. A simple woolen belt cinches her tunic at the waist, holding a small pouch for coins and keys
